token_near_graduation.meaning: the LaunchToken is near reaching BONDING_SUPPLY graduation

pair_deployed_before_graduation.meaning: the (token, quote) pair is deployed before graduation

pair_reserve_token_wei.meaning: internal reserve of tokenA in the pair after the direct deposit and sync

graduation_completed.meaning: graduation at BONDING_SUPPLY completes without reverting, depositing 20% of token and all held quoteReserve into the UniSwapV2 pool

token_transfer_before_graduation.meaning: LaunchToken is transferred before graduation (tokens moved other than by the launchpad and GTE router, or pair accepted as final recipient)

assumptions: The attacker is an unprivileged caller able to deploy the pair and call sync before graduation.
The 20% token and all quoteReserve deposit amounts are intended graduation logic, not observed values.
The pair is deployed by the attacker before graduation and is the pair used by _createPairAndSwapRemaining.

unresolved.description: Report does not state whether the attacker is permissionless/anyone caller; the precondition is treated as an unprivileged attacker scenario.
Report does not give a numeric definition of 'near reaching BONDING_SUPPLY'; represented as a grounded Boolean.

limitations: The no-transfer-before-graduation impact is represented as a Boolean observable because the report gives no numeric transfer-amount definition.
The graduation-success relation is represented as a Boolean completion observable; the 20% token and all quoteReserve deposit amounts are not numerically bound.
The claim that the DoS is permanent for all tokens is asserted but not independently established.
